description: From PR #98 gating audit residual: handle_existing_cluster only bootstraps the system shard and never populates data-shard shard_materializers — so after EVERY epoch change, all data shards go placeholder + on-demand re-recruitment (cold-start latency per recovery), and previously-running data-shard materializers are left behind (potential mass orphaning as new recruits replace them). Pre-Phase-A this manifested as the original uncovered-gap behavior. FDB analogue: storage servers rejoin and are re-adopted. Design: recovery (or the Distributor sweep) should re-lock/re-adopt still-running materializers into coverage rather than recruiting fresh. Relates: bedrock-q67.11 (orphan reconciliation), bedrock-22g (thundering herd — every epoch change currently triggers herd conditions on first reads).
title: Warm-cluster recovery re-covers all data shards via placeholder instead of re-adopting running materializers
